fact: The Council of Ministers record of 1 September 2026 reports the Minister saying at the WSIS ministerial round table that Djibouti's national strategy rests on developing public digital infrastructure, universal Internet access and digital skills; no adopting act or text is named.
title: Travaux de la 9ième séance 01/09/2026
publisher: Présidence de la République de Djibouti
